   [Req-6] - Registered patients can raise consultation requests in two modes: Appointment and Offline.
   [Req-6/1] - Patient creates request by entering symptoms, uploading reports, and choosing mode (Offline/Appointment).
   [Req-6/2] - For Appointment Requests, if appointment is for next day, create entry in Patient Appointment File.
   [Req-6/3] - Batch program runs nightly to create Appointment File for next 5 days (purges existing).
   [Req-7] - Batch program runs periodically to predict diseases and prioritize requests (Critical/Medium/Low).
   [Req-8] - Doctors see prioritized requests and provide diagnosis, prescribe, suggest lab requests.
   [Req-9] - Chemist views open prescriptions (by pincode) and updates status; medicines delivered offline.
